支付重试上限为 3 次：第三方网关的扣款幂等性仅在 3 次内保证，超过 3 次会产生重复扣款风险。修改默认重试次数前必须与支付组确认。
Payment retry limit is 3: gateway idempotency is only guaranteed within 3 attempts; more attempts risk duplicate charges. Confirm with the payment team before changing the default.

退款必须走幂等通道，同一退款单号重复提交不会二次打款。退款金额不得超过原订单实付金额。
Refunds must use the idempotent channel: resubmitting the same refund id never pays twice, and the refund amount must not exceed the original paid amount.
